title: Development and Validation of a Multimodal-Multitask Deep Learning Approach for Estimating Late Distant Recurrence Risk in HR-Positive Early Breast Cancer.
authors: Mamounas, Eleftherios P; Chen, Ming; Sparano, Joseph A; Rahman, Md Ashequr; Cheng, Yating; Wang, Victoria; Gray, Robert J; Rastogi, Priya; Amidi, Eghbal; Geyer, Charles E Jr; Boucher, Tommy; Freeman, Tanner J; Ramzanpour, Mohammadreza; Varma, Mukund; Ghani, Hassan; Cheng, Caleb; Bales, Casey; Ribeiro, Jennifer R; Bandos, Hanna; Stransky, Nicolas; Miglarese, Mark R; Oberley, Matthew; Spetzler, David; Radovich, Milan; Sledge, George W; Wolmark, Norman
one_liner_zh: 该研究开发多模态深度学习模型预测HR阳性早期乳腺癌晚期远处复发风险，对象为临床病理图像与预后，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，方法亦非针对分子互作建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Late distant recurrence (DR) remains a persistent risk in hormone receptor-positive (HR+) early breast cancer after completion of 5 years of endocrine therapy (ET). We developed and validated a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) model to improve long-term risk stratification and to explore heterogeneity in benefit from extended letrozole therapy (ELT). The deep learning model integrating digitized hematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images with clinicopathologic variables was developed using 2,271 patients from the National Surgical Adjuvant Breast and Bowel Project (NSABP) B-42 trial with five-fold cross-validation and externally validated in 4,300 patients from the TAILORx trial who were disease-free at 5 years from the initial diagnosis. Prognostic performance was evaluated using hazard ratios (HR) and absolute risk differences. Exploratory analyses assessed ELT benefit across model-defined risk groups. In NSABP B-42, the model stratified patients into groups with markedly different outcomes, with a 10-year absolute DR risk difference of 7.95% between high- and low-risk groups [HR, 5.71; 95% confidence interval (CI), 3.5-9.317; P < 0.001]. High-risk patients derived greater absolute benefit from ELT (4.09%) than low-risk patients (0.49%). External validation in the independent TAILORx cohort confirmed prognostic performance, with MI Clarity multimodal-multitask identifying patients with significantly different late DR outcomes (HR, 1.893; 95% CI, 1.413-2.534; P < 0.001). This multimodal AI approach using routine pathology and clinical data enables robust and generalizable stratification of late DR risk in HR+ breast cancer. This scalable strategy may complement existing genomic assays and support more individualized decisions about extended ET. SIGNIFICANCE: Late DR is a major cause of death in HR+ breast cancer, and deciding who needs longer hormone therapy is challenging. Current genomic tests are useful but have limitations. This study shows that an AI model using pathology and clinical data identifies patients at high or low risk of late recurrence. High-risk patients may benefit more from extended hormone therapy, offering an accessible way to guide treatment decisions.
abstract_zh: 晚期远处复发（DR）在激素受体阳性（HR+）早期乳腺癌完成5年内分泌治疗（ET）后仍是一个持续存在的风险。我们开发并验证了一种多模态人工智能（AI）模型，以改善长期风险分层并探索延长来曲唑治疗（ELT）获益的异质性。该深度学习模型整合了数字化苏木精-伊红全切片图像与临床病理变量，使用来自国家外科辅助乳腺和肠道项目（NSABP）B-42试验的2,271名患者进行开发，采用五折交叉验证，并在TAILORx试验中4,300名初始诊断后5年无病生存的患者中进行了外部验证。预后性能通过风险比（HR）和绝对风险差异进行评估。探索性分析评估了模型定义的风险组中ELT的获益。在NSABP B-42中，该模型将患者分为结局显著不同的组别，高风险组与低风险组之间的10年绝对DR风险差异为7.95% [HR, 5.71；95%置信区间（CI），3.5-9.317；P < 0.001]。高风险患者从ELT中获得的绝对获益（4.09%）大于低风险患者（0.49%）。在独立的TAILORx队列中的外部验证确认了预后性能，MI Clarity多模态多任务识别出晚期DR结局显著不同的患者（HR, 1.893；95% CI, 1.413-2.534；P < 0.001）。这种使用常规病理和临床数据的多模态AI方法能够对HR+乳腺癌的晚期DR风险进行稳健且可泛化的分层。这种可扩展的策略可能补充现有的基因组检测，并支持关于延长ET的更具个体化的决策。意义：晚期DR是HR+乳腺癌死亡的主要原因，而决定谁需要更长时间的激素治疗具有挑战性。目前的基因组检测有用但存在局限性。本研究表明，使用病理和临床数据的AI模型能够识别晚期复发高风险或低风险的患者。高风险患者可能从延长激素治疗中获益更多，提供了一种可及的方式来指导治疗决策。
